registryEvidence: The official Egyptian General Survey Authority is the national cadastral/survey custodian and publishes land-map, digital-map, coordinate-certificate and cadastral/title-registration services. Official government material also references an Asyut Survey Directorate in survey documentation. This establishes institutional/procedural registry evidence, not an open Abu Tig parcel endpoint.
